page: Amazon Web Services r6idn.12xlarge is a memory-optimized, storage-enhanced instance built on the AWS Nitro System. Powered by dedicated 3rd Generation Intel Xeon Scalable 8375C processors operating at 3.5 GHz, the instance delivers 48 vCPUs across 24 physical cores with two threads per core. Memory capacity is provisioned at 384 GB of DDR4 memory clocked at 3 GHz, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU allocation designed to sustain high-footprint enterprise applications.

For I/O performance, the r6idn.12xlarge includes 2,850 GB of local NVMe SSD instance store memory, eliminating the latency overhead of network-attached block devices for temporary scratch space and buffer caches. External throughput is anchored by a 75 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating large data ingest and multi-node synchronization without network saturation. The platform includes 54 MB of L3 cache, hardware AES-NI and SHA cryptographic acceleration, and AVX-512 extensions for vectorized computation.

Benchmark results show top-quartile performance in cryptographic throughput and image processing, reflecting the efficiency of the underlying hardware acceleration engines. Multi-threaded decompression, Geekbench compute metrics, and PassMark database operations place securely within the middle tier. In-memory data store evaluations demonstrate over 44 million Redis SET operations per second, confirming predictable throughput under sustained memory load.

The integrated local NVMe storage combined with expansive system memory delivers high resource density for workloads requiring low-latency access to data volumes. Organizations should account for the ephemeral nature of instance store media, ensuring proper replication topologies. The configuration serves in-memory databases such as Redis and Apache Cassandra, distributed caching tiers, large-scale relational database systems, real-time analytics engines, and enterprise ETL pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services r6idn.12xlarge is a memory-optimized Nitro-based cloud instance configured with 48 vCPUs and 24 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8375C processor running at 3.5 GHz. The system provides 384 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-intensive operations. Local high-speed persistence is delivered through an integrated 2,850 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, complemented by 75 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. In empirical benchmarks, the instance demonstrates solid encryption throughput and image processing capabilities alongside consistent middle-tier scores across multi-core compute, Redis transactions, and database operations. Hardware cryptographic instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA extensions support secure processing without significant performance degradation. The configuration offers a balanced resource profile for large in-memory databases, real-time caching layers, big data analytics engines, and high-throughput transactional applications requiring high RAM density and fast local scratch storage.
